Subject: Round-robin interview loop for Redwood — proposed windows

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood — we enjoyed your initial screen. We'd like to move you to a virtual full-loop. The hiring team prefers a round-robin-style sequence (short breaks between rooms) so we can keep momentum and get focused feedback.

Quick ask: can you confirm which of these windows work for you (all times PT)?
- Option A: Tue 31 May — 10:00–14:30 (two 45-min slots + two 60-min slots + 30-min debrief)
- Option B: Wed 1 Jun — 09:00–13:30 (same structure)

If neither works, tell me your availability across those two days and your timezone. I've attached the resume we have and a calendar .ics — if you have an updated resume, please attach it.

Logistics: virtual (Zoom), we'll provide single-sign-on instructions and a meeting link once the sequence is locked. Candidates usually prefer the longer slot earlier — let me know if you'd like coding or system design first.

Thanks,
Marissa

Team — looping you in with Daniel's confirmed preference (Wed 1 Jun, coding first). I sketched a round-robin timeline to minimize context switching and ensure a clean debrief cadence. See proposed_slot_map.pdf attached. High-level: four interview windows plus a compact debrief at the end.

Proposed sequence (PT):
- 09:00–10:00: Coding deep-dive (45 min interview + 15 min buffer) — interviewer: Karthik
- 10:15–11:15: System design (45 + 15) — interviewer: Laura
- 11:30–12:30: Behavioral / role fit (45 + 15) — interviewer: Rafael
- 13:00–14:00: Leadership sync (50 + 10) — panel with hiring manager + TPM
- 14:00–14:30: Internal debrief (scribe + consensus) — request Karthik as scribe or assign who is able

Ops checklist (quick):
- One Zoom room per window, but we will stitch same meeting link and rotate interviewers via breakout rooms if desired.
- Scribe: assign one person who will capture per-interview notes in the scorecard (we prefer shared doc).
- Candidate accessibility: ask if he needs captioning or additional breaks.
- Tech checks: interviewers to drop into "green-room" 10m early.

Can you confirm:
- availability for the times above (I blocked tentatively on the calendar link below),
- who will scribe (Karthik?) and who owns the post-loop score consolidation,
- whether we flip any order to accommodate conflicts.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-virtual-onsite-20270511
Attachment: proposed_slot_map.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
